I changed `_replace_refs` in `fastapi/_compat/v2.py` so it only treats a key as a JSON Schema `$ref` when its value is a string. Previously, a property literally named `"$ref"` (whose value is a schema dict) was mistaken for a reference and skipped during recursion. I checked this with a model that has a `$ref`-aliased field, and OpenAPI generation completed without error. I did not run the repo's test files, and the patch is submitted.
